children: Redhurst CC owns Ibstock's Redhurst quarry, located in South Staffordshire, which has been acquired together with the relevant quarry business and associated assets.
The parties have also entered into a supply agreement for the long-term supply of ceramic clay to Ibstock.

Chief executive Joe Hudson said: "The transaction represents the culmination of a multi-year programme of research, technical assessment and commercialisation of the opportunities presented by the Redhurst calcined clay reserves.

"As well as this being an important step in generating value from the group’s unique land and clay reserves for shareholders, we believe this transaction provides a unique platform to support the wider construction industry’s transition to lower-carbon solutions."
At 1030 GMT, the shares were up 5.6% at 73.15p.
